definitions.explanation: The nut of an oak tree. A familiar sight in autumn in Japan, often collected by children.

examples.japanese: {団栗|どんぐり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{団栗|どんぐり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The children are collecting acorns in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団栗|どんぐり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, many acorns lie scattered on the mountain paths.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{団栗|どんぐり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背比|せくら}べ literally means "height comparison among acorns" — used to describe people or things that are all much the same with no clear winner. Similar to English "much of a muchness."

USAGE:
Usually written in hiragana as どんぐり. The kanji {団栗|どんぐり} is rarely used in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団栗|どんぐり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up acorns
- {団栗|どんぐり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背比|せくら}べ: all much the same, no standout
- {団栗|どんぐり}{拾|ひろ}い: acorn gathering
